facts: Vultr was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, Florida.
Vultr is a registered trademark of The Constant Company, LLC.
Vultr is an American cloud computing company providing cloud infrastructure across 185 countries.
Vultr is available in 33 cloud data center regions across six continents.
pros: Pay-as-you-go model where users pay only for what they use.
On-demand clusters of Bare Metal servers can be provisioned without manual intervention.
Extensive global footprint spanning 33 data center regions across six continents.
